interface.longDescription: OMEGA v24 extends the cumulative OMEGA/ASGARD system with a production-oriented ElevenLabs media and voice plane. It provides secret-ref-only authentication, explicit credit-consumption approvals, Speech Engine configuration and upstream contract validation, low-latency streaming guidance, music composition, multi-voice dialogue, sound effects, voice isolation and voice changing, forced alignment, dubbing lifecycle support and asynchronous image/video generation while preserving Reality Filter, KRATOS and THOR release gates.
defaultPrompt: Use OMEGA v9 to execute this engineering task end to end with observed evidence and maximum justified autonomy.

Use omega_meta_architect for negotiation/TCO, decision matrices, failure memory, drift, service discovery, DAG execution, latency budgets, confidence gates, shadow comparisons and knowledge graph operations.
Never claim online DPO, federated weight synchronization, hidden chain-of-thought auditing, or research-equivalent training unless a real external trainer or verifier actually performed it.
